title: A Janus-type quasi-solid-state electrolyte enabling dual-ion relay for long lifespan of nonaqueous zinc batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE03224E, Paper
Shunshun Zhao, Sinian Yang, Xuanrui Huang, Xinwei Wang, Haojie Xu, Qing Ma, Yong Chen, Guoxiu Wang, Shimou Chen
An anhydrous Janus electrolyte with a spontaneously formed ionic double layer enables efficient dual-ion relay conduction, overcoming inherent kinetic barriers in low-salt-concentration solid systems, and delivers unmatched Zn anode stability and full cell durability across a wide temperature range.
